checks.evidence: Every Kiota, official-kernel, fixture and inherited-pair input is bound by repository-relative path, byte size and SHA-256.

The design fixes the elimination level, recursor level order, motive type/order, minor field/IH type/order, target indices, major premise and result for every group member, mapped to official lines 478-790.
The design includes discovery, specialization, breadth-first closure, base construction, restoration, auxiliary recursor naming and post-restoration type checking, mapped to official lines 887-1259.

Current-block recursors remain absent while supplied types are inferred and compared; reconstruction uses only checked types, constructors and the prior environment. Reusing a supplied universe identifier is restricted to an alpha binder label.

Structural and normalized-structural alternatives are rejected with explicit reasons. Positional universe alpha-normalization plus Kiota-native definitional equality is fail-closed, followed by unconditional replacement with the reconstructed type.
The design records that Kiota's Pi conversion ignores BinderInfo and that imported terms are already elaborated; canonical generated BinderInfo therefore does not weaken kernel typing.
The one-scalar pair remains unchanged; the mismatching LALNest fifth domain must reject and the LALWrap LALNest control must accept.
The frozen accepted set spans indexed ordinary, same-container nested specializations, deep parametric nesting and a mutual-plus-nested group with six motives and nineteen minors.
The item performed no checker launch, build, production edit, generated scientific byte, network request, catalog edit or external action.

adversarial_requirements: Changing the selected relation away from definitional equality plus replacement must fail validation.
Permitting supplied current-block recursors in the comparison environment must fail validation.
Omitting any base or nested construction stage must fail validation.
Changing a fixture or pair hash, expected outcome or static shape profile must fail validation.
Claiming production authorization or any forbidden action count must fail validation.
